content.title: italki - $30/st jump in southern markets. what does the abbreviation "st" mean?
content.text: Лера Колесникова$30/st jump in southern markets. what does the abbreviation "st" mean?Sep 5, 2021 7:04 PM51Answers · 5BBenCommunity Tutor0Hi Valeria, st is an abbreviation of "Stone". It's one of unit of mass.September 6, 202100RRigo0Hi. Estoy aprendiendo inglés...SaludosSeptember 5, 202100CCharlie CollingwoodProfessional Teacher0'short ton': a unit of weight equal to 2000 pounds or 907.184 kilogramsSeptember 5, 202100GGuideDogSaint李凯森0Depending on context it could be 'stone' as in a measure of weight.September 5, 202100LLokiProfessional Teacher0I've honestly never heard this before (I have basic investment knowledge) and Google wasn't much help either. My only suggestion is that it means $30 per stock, i.e. the stock price jumped by $30. People wouldn't normally write that though, as it's obvious that 'price' means 'price per stock'.September 5, 202100Still haven’t found your answers?
